written.headline: Ethan Mollick shares Anthropic data on AI impact across scientific fields
written.summary: Ethan Mollick shared new Anthropic data indicating that AI could take on 27–52% of researcher time needed to produce a new study, with a median of 38% across fields. The data examines the potential impact of AI on the sciences by field.

written.headline: Google acquires southeast Wyoming data center site from Crusoe
written.summary: Google acquired Crusoe's pre-developed data center site in southeast Wyoming, taking over the project after Crusoe completed site selection, governmental approvals, and power strategy work. The site was initially part of a project designed for a 1.8-gigawatt AI data-center campus with expansion potential up to 10 gigawatts.

written.headline: India focused on becoming AI application capital of the world: Ashwini Vaishnaw
written.summary: Union Electronics and Information Technology Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that India is focused on becoming the artificial intelligence application capital of the world. He also announced the launch of the Semicon 2.0 Web Application Portal alongside updates on domestic semiconductor and electronics manufacturing.

written.headline: Parents sue Google over AI-related mental health crisis on school Chromebook
written.summary: Parents in North Carolina filed a lawsuit against Google alleging that its AI-powered search and chatbot tools on a school-issued Chromebook triggered a severe mental health crisis in their 13-year-old daughter. The complaint states that the student exchanged thousands of messages detailing anxiety, depression, and suicide methods over several months.

written.headline: Anthropic developing AI systems twice as fast as a year ago, report says
written.summary: An independent analysis by the nonprofit Model Evaluation and Threat Research found that Anthropic is developing its AI systems about twice as quickly as a year ago. The findings were released as Anthropic prepares for an initial public offering of stock.

written.headline: Coforge joins SpaceX partner network to deploy Grok for clients
written.summary: Coforge Limited joined the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network as a Transformation Partner to deploy Grok AI tools for enterprise clients. The company will use its Momentuum blue engineering unit to build and run production solutions in client environments.
